metadata.universe_scope: 4 Active Contracts (GOLDM, GOLDTEN, GOLDGUINEA, GOLDPETAL). Standard GOLD (1 kg) contract excluded from active universe.

GOLD.status_note: Excluded from active 4-product universe. Specifications retained for historical audit trail.
GOLD.price_quote_basis: Ex-Ahmedabad (inclusive of import duty/taxes, excluding GST)
GOLD.specification_notes: Standard 1 kg gold bar with certified fineness of 995 (99.5% pure gold).

GOLDM.price_quote_basis: Ex-Ahmedabad (inclusive of import duty/taxes, excluding GST)
GOLDM.source_title: MCX Contract Specification — Gold Mini Futures (FUTCOM)
GOLDM.specification_notes: 100g bar contract with certified fineness of 995 (99.5% pure gold).

GOLDTEN.price_quote_basis: Ex-Ahmedabad (inclusive of import duty/taxes, excluding GST)
GOLDTEN.source_title: MCX Circular — Launch of Gold 10 Grams Futures Contract
GOLDTEN.circular_reference: MCX Launch Circular dated March 2025 (trading started 2025-03-31)
GOLDTEN.specification_notes: Launched March 31, 2025. 10g denomination with 999 purity (24 karat).

GOLDGUINEA.price_quote_basis: Ex-Ahmedabad (inclusive of import duty/taxes, excluding GST)
GOLDGUINEA.source_title: MCX Contract Specification — Gold Guinea Futures (FUTCOM)
GOLDGUINEA.specification_notes: Official MCX Gold Guinea specifications mandate 999 purity (serially numbered coins/bars supplied by LBMA/MCX approved refiners with certicard). Final settlement Due Date Rate (DDR) is derived from polled Ahmedabad 995 spot price scaled by (999/995) to convert to 999 purity standard.

GOLDPETAL.price_quote_basis: Ex-Ahmedabad (inclusive of import duty/taxes, excluding GST)
GOLDPETAL.source_title: MCX Contract Specification — Gold Petal Futures (FUTCOM)
GOLDPETAL.specification_notes: 1g micro contract with certified 999 purity (24 karat fineness).
